title: ركعتا الفجر
sources: Sahih Muslim 725 · Qur'an 17:78 (recited by Nasser Al-Qatami, everyayah.com)

beats.voice: دقيقتانِ... خيرٌ منَ الدُّنيا وما فيها.

subs.text: …better than the world and everything in it.

beats.voice: كلُّ ما تراهُ عيناك... مالُها، وقصورُها، وزينتُها.

subs.text: Everything your eyes can see: its wealth, its palaces, its beauty.

beats.voice: ركعتانِ خفيفتانِ قبلَ صلاةِ الفجر... أثمنُ من ذلكَ كلِّه.

subs.text: Two light rak‘ahs before the Fajr prayer are worth more than all of it.

lines.html: «رَكْعَتَا الْفَجْرِ خَيْرٌ مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا»

subs.text: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said:
“The two rak‘ahs of Fajr are better than the world and everything in it.”<small>Sahih Muslim 725 · the two sunnah rak‘ahs before Fajr</small>

beats.voice: والنّاسُ نيام... قُمْ أنتَ، وخُذْ نصيبَك. قالَ اللهُ تعالى:

subs.text: While people sleep, rise and take your share.

lines.html: ﴿أَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِدُلُوكِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ إِلَىٰ غَسَقِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَقُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡفَجۡرِۖ إِنَّ قُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡفَجۡرِ كَانَ مَشۡهُودࣰا﴾
سورة الإسراء · الآية ٧٨ · بصوت ناصر القطامي

subs.text: “Establish prayer from the sun’s decline until the darkness of night, and the recitation of dawn. Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.”<small>Qur’an 17:78 · recited by Nasser Al-Qatami</small>

beats.voice: لا تُفوِّتْها غدًا. أرسِلْها لمن يُوقِظُكَ للفجر.

subs.text: Don’t miss it tomorrow. Send this to the one who wakes you for Fajr.
